description: This file defines the 'StreamDirectory' class, which manages streams associated with a specific silo in the Orleans streaming infrastructure. It handles creation, cleanup, and disposal of streams, and provides mechanisms to ensure type safety and resource management.

classes.name: StreamDirectory
classes.description: Manages stream objects associated with a silo, supporting addition, cleanup, and disposal operations.

methods.name: GetOrAddStream
methods.description: Retrieves an existing stream of specified type or creates and adds a new one if not present, ensuring type safety.

methods.name: Cleanup
methods.description: Performs cleanup of streams, optionally for producers and consumers, unless suppressed by test control.

methods.name: Clear
methods.description: Clears all streams from the directory, used mainly for testing.

methods.name: GetStreamControl
methods.description: Retrieves the control interface for a specific stream if available.

methods.name: GetUsedStreamIds
methods.description: Returns a list of all stream identifiers currently stored.

methods.name: DisposeAsync
methods.description: Asynchronous disposal of the stream directory, performing cleanup of streams.
